name: markdown-ai-translator
description: AI-powered translation for Markdown files with strict syntax preservation. Supports OpenAI, Claude, OpenRouter, MiniMax, DeepSeek, and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

enumDescriptions: OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions API. Works with OpenAI, OpenRouter, MiniMax, DeepSeek, Together, Groq, Ollama, vLLM, LM Studio, etc.
markdownAiTranslator.provider.description: Which API protocol to speak. Pick 'anthropic' only when calling the native Anthropic API directly; for Claude via OpenRouter use 'openai-compatible'.

markdownAiTranslator.endpoint.description: Base URL of the LLM endpoint. Examples: https://api.openai.com/v1, https://openrouter.ai/api/v1, https://api.anthropic.com/v1, https://api.minimaxi.chat/v1, https://api.deepseek.com/v1, http://localhost:11434/v1.

markdownAiTranslator.apiKey.markdownDescription: API key for the configured endpoint. **Tip:** put this in your *User* settings, not workspace settings, so it isn't committed to git.

markdownAiTranslator.model.description: Model identifier passed to the API (e.g. gpt-4o-mini, claude-sonnet-4-6, anthropic/claude-3.5-sonnet, MiniMax-Text-01, deepseek-chat).

markdownAiTranslator.targetLanguage.description: Default target language (e.g. 'Simplified Chinese', 'Japanese', 'Spanish', 'Brazilian Portuguese'). Use the 'Translate Document To…' command to choose ad hoc.

markdownAiTranslator.additionalInstructi.description: Extra instructions appended to the system prompt — tone, glossary, regional preferences, etc.

markdownAiTranslator.temperature.description: Sampling temperature. Keep low (0.0–0.3) for technical docs.

markdownAiTranslator.stream.description: Stream the translation as it arrives so the preview fills in progressively.

enumDescriptions: Open VS Code's Markdown preview to the side (rendered).
Open the translated Markdown source in a side editor.
Open both: source editor and rendered preview.
markdownAiTranslator.previewMode.description: How to display the translation. Nothing is written to disk — use 'Save As…' from the source view if you want to keep it.

markdownAiTranslator.extraHeaders.description: Extra HTTP headers to send with every request (e.g. {"HTTP-Referer": "https://my-app", "X-Title": "My App"} for OpenRouter ranking).
